name: public-proposal
description: English orchestration layer for evidence-bound Korean public proposals.

interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate Korean public-proposal research, authoring, and QA.
interface.longDescription: Routes proposal work through the KPP CLI while preserving issuer standards, visual evidence, research provenance, Korean prose review, and human approval boundaries.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $public-proposal to plan, author, audit, and release an evidence-bound Korean public proposal with the bundled Korean authority snapshot. For academic_research, research_service, and policy_research, route through LongTable and bind a valid research lock before approval-ready authoring; keep KPP as the sole state, receipt, approval, and release writer.
